note: Beside the village of Shell Lake at the Hwy 3/12 junction. Sites sit among pines and poplars in five loops; showers, a beach, boat launch, seasonal and weekly boat moorings, mini golf and an 18-hole grass-green golf course. Only those 19 and older may rent a site; the gate is staffed around the clock in summer. --Claude
summary: Keep. 144 sites, 109 sold nightly online (Let's Camp; ~76%+ nightly), all 30 A, no water/sewer at the site. flags: WATERFRONT not waterfront -> lakeview. Loop E (~53.2986-53.2995, -107.0545 to -107.0555) is the lakeside loop: on the operator map its perimeter road runs between E1/E14 and the shore, and on Esri z17 the shore there carries a road and a row of mooring docks.
